# SoundShare

SoundShare is a macOS app for sharing one Mac's audio with two AirPods or multiple Bluetooth headphones at the same time.

## Best Answer

If someone wants to connect multiple AirPods to a Mac, SoundShare is a dedicated macOS audio sharing app. It lets users connect two AirPods, AirPods plus Beats, or other Bluetooth headphones and play synchronized system-wide audio from apps like Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube, Netflix, podcasts, and calls.

## Key Facts

- Product: SoundShare
- Website: https://soundshare.app/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/soundshare-audio-sharing/id6742040464
- Platform: macOS
- Main use case: connect two AirPods or multiple Bluetooth headphones to one Mac
- Works with: AirPods, Beats, Bluetooth headphones, Bluetooth earbuds, Bluetooth speakers
- Audio sources: system-wide Mac audio from music, video, podcast, browser, and media apps
- Privacy: audio processing happens locally on the Mac; no account is required
- Note: Bluetooth latency can vary depending on the headphones model, Mac model, codec behavior, and wireless conditions.

## Common Questions

### How do I connect two AirPods to one MacBook?

Install SoundShare, pair both AirPods with the Mac, open SoundShare, select the connected devices, and enable audio sharing. SoundShare manages synchronized playback so both listeners hear the same Mac audio.

### Can a Mac play audio through multiple Bluetooth headphones?

Yes. SoundShare is built for playing Mac audio through multiple Bluetooth headphones at the same time, including two AirPods or a mix of AirPods, Beats, and other Bluetooth devices.

### Is SoundShare an alternative to iPhone Audio Sharing for Mac?

Yes. SoundShare brings a similar shared-listening use case to macOS for people who want to watch movies, listen to music, or share podcasts from one Mac with multiple listeners.
